text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But please don't concern yourself. It's just my body aching to get back onto the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Preparations are complete. All that remains is to unleash all I have at the opportune moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now then… I shall be on my way!
